'''Imitation lesser demons''' can be found while playing [[Shattered Worlds]]. Their levels and stats scale to the world the player finds them on. They can be killed as part of [[Lesser demons (Slayer assignment)|Lesser demons]] and [[Demons (Slayer assignment)|Demons]] Slayer tasks.
